summary: Full regression on MEDILO structural refactor (backend split into config/models/services/routers, frontend CustomerManagement.js split into pages/ops/customers/*). Backend: 29/29 pytest cases pass across public, auth, customer, ops, pharmacies, pharmacist, pharmacy, delivery, invoice PDF, and notification broadcast. Frontend: Ops dashboard (6 tabs) + refactored Customer Management (4 sub-tabs, detail dialog, tickets, notifications, analytics) all work; customer login + home + all 7 profile sub-pages load; invoice download button visible on delivered order; pharmacist, pharmacy staff, and delivery partner dashboards all load with correct data. No behavior regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: Testability: Only nav-customers has a data-testid in /app/frontend/src/pages/ops/Dashboard.js. nav-orders, nav-medicines, nav-pharmacies, nav-users, nav-audit are missing data-testid attributes -- these should be added for consistent test automation. This is pre-existing and unrelated to the refactor.

Docs mismatch: /app/memory/test_credentials.md lists delivery as 'delivery@medilo.com / test123', but /api/auth/delivery/login requires 'phone'. The actual seeded delivery partner is phone '9988776655'. Update the credentials file (or add a delivery seed with the documented email/phone) to prevent confusion for future testing agents.

server.py refactor is clean (thin composition of routers + startup migration + CORS). Consider moving the startup category migration into a scripts/ one-off migration file eventually -- it currently runs on every process start.

Frontend refactor of CustomerManagement into pages/ops/customers/{CustomersTab,SupportTab,NotificationsTab,AnalyticsTab,shared}.js is well-scoped; shared.js correctly centralizes helpers/dialogs; no cross-tab prop-drilling issues observed.
